title: Elegant Crumbly Uruguayan Hazelnuts Empanada
description: A delicious and comforting Uruguayan dish featuring crumbly pastry, hazelnuts, and tangy pickles. Perfect for a lazy Sunday afternoon.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the all-purpose flour, graham flour, and salt. Gradually add the softened butter, using a pastry blender or your fingertips to work it into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Roll out the pastry crust to a thickness of about 1/8 inch (3 mm).
Transfer the pastry to a 9-inch (23 cm) tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a separate bowl, mix together the chopped hazelnuts, pickle relish, onion, garlic, and beaten eggs.
Spread the hazelnut mixture evenly over the pastry crust, leaving a 1/2-inch (1 cm) border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the pastry up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Use a sharp knife to cut a decorative border around the edges of the tart.
Bake the empanada for 35-40 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is set.
Let the empanada cool for at least 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
